subject: OpenForge - maintainer credits request / issuance
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@openforge.dev>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OpenForge — request for maintainer/community credits

Hi Alex,

I run OpenForge (https://github.com/openforge) — a small, volunteer-run OSS project that supports modular build tooling for indie devs. We've had a bunch of users start experimenting with LLM integrations and I wanted to check if Redwood offers any community/maintainer credits that we can use to prototype features and publish examples for our contributors.

Quick details:
- GitHub org: openforge
- Primary contact: priya@openforge.dev
- Estimated usage for prototype: ~200k tokens/month (varies)
- Intended use: demo apps, CI tests, and a public example that would point back to Redwood in docs

Is there a self-serve path or a simple approval process? If helpful, I can attach a short maintainer verification (org README + maintainer email list).

Thanks for considering — appreciate any help.

Best,
Priya Desai
Maintainer, OpenForge
https://openforge.dev

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@openforge.dev>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OpenForge — request for maintainer/community credits

Hi Priya — thanks for reaching out and for maintaining OpenForge, this looks great.

We do have a community maintainer program that can issue self-serve credits for OSS projects. To get this moving quickly, can you confirm two small things:
1) A public link we can use to verify maintainer status (README or contributor file is fine).
2) The best email to provision the credits under (team billing vs personal).

Once we have that, I can loop in Sales Ops (Lauren) to issue a promo code and provide a redemption link — typically we give a 6–12 month window depending on the request size. Also CC'ing Grace from CS so we can track any onboarding docs or example prompts you'd like us to add to the community hub.

If you prefer, we can handle the issuance entirely self-serve (you'll get a promo code and a one-click redeem flow) — otherwise we can do manual grant.

Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Desai <priya@openforge.dev>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OpenForge — request for maintainer/community credits

Thanks Alex — attaching a quick maintainer verification (org README + contributor list).

Link to repo: https://github.com/openforge/openforge-core
Maintainer page: https://openforge.dev/team
Preferred provisioning email: credits@openforge.dev (this forwards to the core team)
Estimated cadence: 200k tokens/month for the first 3 months; if the demos land we expect that to rise.

Attachment: maintainer-proof.pdf (README & contributor list)

If possible, a 6-month window would be ideal. Self-serve promo code is fine — makes it easier for our volunteers to redeem.

Appreciate your help — Priya

From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@openforge.dev>
Cc: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OpenForge — request for maintainer/community credits

Hi Priya — pleased to help. We reviewed the materials and verified the maintainer list. Approving a promotional credit grant:

- Amount: USD 4,000 in platform credits
- Promo code (self-serve): RF-OPENF-202508
- Redemption URL: https://app.redwood.com/redeem?code=RF-OPENF-202508
- Valid for: 12 months from issuance (expires 2026-08-17)
- Applies to: API usage (text generation, embeddings). Not applicable retroactively to prior invoices.

Next steps for you:
1) Redeem the code via the link above using the provisioning email (credits@openforge.dev). That will attach the credits to the account and show the remaining balance in the Billing UI.
2) If you want the credits applied to a different billing email later (e.g., company billing), reply here and we can transfer the grant to a verified billing contact — we typically require confirmation from the target account owner.

Attached: credit-issuance.csv (internal record). I've added a HubSpot note: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/12345?company=OpenForge

Let us know when you've redeemed and if you'd like a short onboarding session with Grace.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Desai <priya@openforge.dev>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OpenForge — request for maintainer/community credits

Hi Lauren — thank you, we redeemed the code successfully and can see the balance in the Billing UI. Really appreciate the quick turnaround.

One question: can we apply the credits to our team billing (billing@openforge.dev) instead of credits@openforge.dev in case we move things to a consolidated account later? If so, what's the verification step — does the billing owner need to reply here?

Also would be great to book a 30-minute onboarding with Grace next week to walk through best-practices for cost controls and batching.

Best,
Priya
